parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region ID of the SLB instance.

You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~27584~~) operation to query the most recent region list.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun slb delete-load-balancer --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --load-balancer-id lb-bp1h66tp5uat800000000 --api-version 2014-05-15 --region cn-hangzhou
